name: Board Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the
  Westlake Village Community Foundation
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  Tuesday, April 26, 2022 12:00 Noon

  Written comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org
  no later than 9:00 a.m. on Tuesday, April 26, 2022. Written comments will be summarized
  during the meeting.

  Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, Westlake Village Community Foundation Board
Members and staff are participating in this meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government
  Code Section 54953(e).

  In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, a physical location is not being
 provided for the public to attend or comment. Members of the public may observe the meeting
 telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service, and may offer
  comment in real time, with the following steps:

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88521786436
  Webinar ID: 885 2178 6436
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16699009128,,88521786436# or +12532158782,,88521786436#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 or +1 253 215 8782 or +1 346 248 7799

Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification
or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call
the City at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and distributed
by the Board Members less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for public inspection at City
Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours.
 CALL TO ORDER:  12:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Foundation Members Brutzkus, Croner, Honig, Halpern and
  McSweeney

PUBLIC COMMENTS:  Members of the public may address the Administrative Committee. Please
observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or
otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as list on Page 1 of this agenda.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Approval of the February 22, 2022 Meeting Minutes

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  1. Discussion on the Foundations 2022 Scholarship Program
  2. Financial Update

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, April 21, 2022 at 4:30 p.m. on the City website and in the Posting
Board at City Hall.
